# NXExtract 1.1.1

Maintenance release improving first-run diagnostics for ports that migrate an
already installed Android payload.

## Changes

- every ABI rejected during existing-data adoption now records the exact
  full-validation error in the local extractor log;
- adoption validation remains strict and unchanged;
- a synthetic regression test covers the diagnostic;
- the maintenance path and full output verification were revalidated on
  AArch64 Mali-450, Mali-G310 and R36S-class devices.

The AArch64 UI is unchanged from 1.1.0 and still requires only GLIBC 2.17.
No APK, OBB, game library, game asset or other proprietary data is included.
